section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a single study that investigated a model of learning transfer within a complex decision-making task. The study examined how individual differences, learning strategies, and training outcomes influenced transfer of learning to a more complex task. It involved 93 undergraduate students and found that mastery orientation was related to metacognitive activity, which in turn was related to knowledge acquisition, skilled performance, self-efficacy, and ultimately performance on a transfer task.
